scope: NCollection_UtfIterator::ChangeBufferHere through exclusively borrowed writable storage
integration_status: Committed branch candidate; root integration and worktree deletion pending

declaration_bindings.scope: Exclusive, live, in-bounds code-unit storage; returns remaining writable slice with actual native current offset.

behavior: All decoding, advancing, validity and output conversion reuse the existing UtfIterator implementation through a short immutable view. No unsafe code or synthetic allocation is added.

Changing a stored symbol leaves the decoded symbol and cached next offset unchanged. Advancing uses that cached offset; rewinding or rebinding decodes again and resets the index. Native UTF8 multibyte and UTF16 surrogate mutations join all10 observation rows.

The mutable remainder points into the original allocation; null yields None and one-past-end yields an empty slice. Synthetic padded positions beyond one-past-end yield None. Pointer identity is covered under strict-provenance Miri.
Signed UTF16 mutations retain the established native sign-promotion behavior. Shared views cannot coexist with an exclusive write through the safe borrowed API.
remaining_gaps: Native simultaneously writable copied iterators and external aliases require a separate lifetime/provenance contract; UtfIteratorMut intentionally does not implement Copy or Clone.
ChangeBufferHere through the original shared-slice UtfIterator is still unavailable. This binding requires the caller to provide genuinely writable exclusive storage.
Null native increment and accesses outside actual allocation are undefined and are excluded from native probes. Rust retains checked null increment and zero-padded read semantics.
Platform wchar_t configurations and arbitrary size-dispatched native types remain outside this bounded binding.
